basis: Deterministic Job 65-style fixture reproducing the supplied real-PDF page labels, headings, false fragments, and Notes range.

original_defect.reliable_signal: Strong financial-statement headings supported Arabic offset +1.
original_defect.pollution: Weak fragment anchors contributed incompatible offsets and made the strong alignment unreliable.
original_defect.notes_impact: The printed Notes range 15-22 did not yield a populated PDF range.

weighted_consensus.acceptance_policy: At least two anchors, at least 72% weighted support, and no competing offset backed by two or more tier A/B anchors.
weighted_consensus.piecewise_support: Roman and Arabic/reset regimes remain separate and require trusted local support.

conservation.interpretation: Unassigned cover/TOC evidence is conserved and reported; no evidence is silently dropped.

decision: Trusted weighted +1 consensus correctly projects the complete Notes range and materially reduces the reproduced unassigned rate while preserving zero dropped evidence. A new real Job 65 artifact is still required for a live-document verdict.
